test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Find the peak NOT in the Western Ghats.

Anamudi, Agasthyamalai, Doddabetta, Nanda Devi
solution:
Here,

__
 
• Anamudi, Agasthyamalai, and Doddabetta are peaks in the **Western Ghats**.**
 

While,

 
• Nanda Devi is located in the **Himalayas**.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 
 
**Nanda Devi:** This is the second-highest mountain in India and is located in the **Himalayas** (specifically the Garhwal section in Uttarakhand). It is thousands of kilometers away from the Western Ghats.

 
 
• 
 
**Anamudi:** Located in Kerala, this is the highest peak in the Western Ghats and all of South India.

 
 
• 
 
**Agasthyamalai:** Located at the southern end of the Western Ghats on the border of Kerala and Tamil Nadu. It is famous for the Agasthyamala Biosphere Reserve.

 
 
• 
 
**Doddabetta:** This is the highest point in the Nilgiri Mountains, which are a major range within the Western Ghats system in Tamil Nadu.
